intent.proves: No channel (ShopType 3) is without a group that holds products.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global; at least one subject must be in scope

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT CAST(s.ShopId AS nvarchar(50)) + N' ' + CAST(s.ShopName AS nvarchar(100)) FROM EcomShops s WHERE s.ShopType = 3 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomShopGroupRelation r JOIN EcomGroupProductRelation gp ON gp.GroupProductRelationGroupId = r.ShopGroupGroupId WHERE r.ShopGroupShopId = s.ShopId)
bindings.subjectsQuery: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomShops s WHERE s.ShopType = 3
